INSERT INTO transacciones (
                comprador_id,
                creador_id,
                sample_id,
                tipo,
                monto,
                moneda,
                pago_creador,
                comision_plataforma,
                estado,
                stripe_payment_id,
                idempotency_key
            )
            VALUES (
                $1,
                $1,
                NULL,
                'payout',
                CAST($2 AS text)::numeric,
                $3,
                0,
                0,
                $4,
                $5,
                $6
            )
            ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
